# Loopwright

> Loopwright is a TypeScript harness and GitHub Action/App control plane for bounded, verified work.

Documentation version: main. Source revision: dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7.
These pages come from the repository's docs/ sources. For version-specific behavior, use the
documentation and code for your release. This index routes questions; follow its links for evidence.

## Getting Started

- [Architecture](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/getting-started/architecture/index.md): Execution stages, operating modes, trust boundaries, and configuration map
- [Installation](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/getting-started/installation/index.md): Install the CLI on a laptop or wire the GitHub Action

## Operations

- [GitHub Action](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/operations/github-action/index.md): Configure and run the reusable GitHub Action
- [GitHub App](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/operations/github-app/index.md): Deploy and configure the GitHub App control plane
- [CLI](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/operations/cli/index.md): Generate drafts, inspect runs, reconcile, and audit closure
- [Coding Agents](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/operations/coding-agents/index.md): Drive zero-secret delegated step loops from host coding agents

## Walkthroughs

- [Declarative Taskpack](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/walkthroughs/declarative-taskpack/index.md): Author or migrate a single-file repository taskpack
- [Managed Controller](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/walkthroughs/managed-controller/index.md): Configure out-of-repo registries, contracts, and CLI runs
- [Evolutionary Campaign](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/walkthroughs/evolutionary-campaign/index.md): Run bounded island optimization with hardware gates and bundle export

## Configuration

- [Taskpack](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/configuration/taskpack/index.md): Configure .loopwright/taskpack.yaml and multi-domain TaskpackSuite manifests
- [Task Contract](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/configuration/task-contract/index.md): Configure task goals, scope, roles, budgets, DAGs, and evidence
- [Controller and Registry](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/configuration/controller-and-registry/index.md): Configure approved handlers, profiles, credentials, and controls
- [Sandbox Backends](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/configuration/sandbox-backends/index.md): Select OS or container sandboxes and required capabilities
- [Decision Routing](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/configuration/decision-routing/index.md): Configure advisory routing policies, providers, and thresholds
- [Evolution Campaign](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/docs/configuration/evolution-campaign/index.md): Configure stages, islands, objectives, budgets, teamEvolution, and export

## Reference

- [Reference Hub](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/references/README.md): Task routing, exact resource aliases, and evidence labels for flat references
- [Bootstrap Interview Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/references/bootstrap-interview.md): Interactive agent interview protocol for Mode 1, Mode 2, and Mode 3 setup
- [Taskpack and Contract Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/references/taskpack-and-contract-schema.md): Complete field, bound, and enum dictionary for Taskpack, TaskContract, and EvolutionCampaign
- [Controller and Registry Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/references/controller-and-registry-schema.md): Complete TrustedRegistry, ControllerConfig, and DecisionPolicy field and hook tables
- [CLI and Action Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/references/cli-and-action-reference.md): Exhaustive action.yml inputs, CLI subcommand flags, exit codes, and GitHubAppConfig
- [Coding Agent Protocol Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/main/references/coding-agent-protocol.md): StepYield JSON schema, lease diagnostics, exit codes, and verified overlay-apply script

## Optional

- [Repository navigation](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/README.md): Module relationships, design records, code entry points and applicable skills for contributors.
- [Development and Verification](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/development.md): Build, test, lint, and verify workspace changes
- [Workspace Internals and Boundaries](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/internals.md): Navigate package layers, code ownership, and invariants
- [Canonical Identity and Digests](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/identity.md): Implement RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization and SHA-256 digests
- [Verification Evidence and Authority](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/evidence.md): Implement independent check hooks and HMAC gate receipts
- [Persistent Local State Store](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/state.md): Implement SQLite WAL lease fencing and monotonic clock guards
- [Isolated Pi Runtime Adapter](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/pi-adapter.md): Implement isolated Pi sessions, brokers, and secret scrubbing
- [Runner Taskpack and Offline Parity](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/runner-taskpack.md): Maintain runner parity and frozen taskpack fixtures
- [Reviewed Memory and CAS Compaction](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/memory.md): Implement CAS reviewed memory proposals and compaction
- [GitHub App Control Plane Internals](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/github-app-internals.md): Implement webhook verification, intake gates, and compilation
- [Capability Closure Matrix and Failure Semantics](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/closure-matrix.md): Maintain capability closure ledger and failure injection suites
- [ADR 0001: Local State Authority](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/adr/0001-local-state-authority.md): Record the fenced local SQLite authority decision
- [ADR 0002: Isolated Pi SDK](https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/blob/dedec1dc8452ea04e5b0ea9ffd76e4944d580ae7/docs/contribute/adr/0002-isolated-pi-sdk.md): Record the isolated Pi runtime boundary decision
